name: LAI-02 Route Governance Review
actions: Get opportunity and active governance assessment
Validate business sponsor and accountable owner
Build reviewer list from risk and data classification matrix
Create parallel review tasks for Legal Technology Security Privacy Data and Platform as applicable
Wait for approve reject or request-information responses
Update assessment decision stage RAG and next milestone
Create one AuditEvent per reviewer decision
Notify submitter owner sponsor and PMO

decision_rules.rejected: Any Critical control failure or final accountable rejection
decision_rules.conditional: Approval with documented conditions owner and due date
decision_rules.approved: All mandatory reviewers complete and final accountable approval recorded

timeout: Escalate after two business days and mark Amber; do not auto-approve
